lastCompletedStory.title: Interactive review/plan in-pane with sentinel detection

nextStoryContext: US-012 adds implementerMode:'sentinel' to runSupervisor. The sentinel polling loop injects sleepFn/nowMs/pollIntervalMs; production callers (next.ts) should inject Bun.sleepSync for real delays if needed. parseAnySentinel() in result.ts detects CAM_IMPLEMENTER_STATUS, CAM_REVIEWER_STATUS, and <review> tags. buildImplementerWorkerArgv now accepts interactive:true (no -p, no --output-format, no wait-for chain). DEFAULT_POLL_INTERVAL_MS = 5000 exported from loop.ts.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed: capture-pane -p routes output to stdout; -S start-line sets the scan start (negative = history). The -N flag in the story notes is a separate formatting flag (preserve trailing spaces), not an end-line bound. End-line is set via -E. Our capturePane is injectable so actual tmux flags are the caller's concern; no mismatch in the loop implementation.
